entities.summary: Dewarick Antwain Spencer is an American professional basketball player who plays for AlKaramah SC of the Syrian Basketball League. Nicknamed "Dee," he is 6 ft 4 in (1.93 m) tall and plays both point guard and shooting guard positions.
